_comment: Copy to ~/.wk/projects.json (wk-steward init does it) and edit. weight 1-10 = share of visits. goal, audience and number are YOUR words: the steward treats them as facts. Never put emails, phone numbers or customer data here; a brief that holds any is refused.

projects.name: My site
projects.goal: A small site that teaches one skill and earns a first sale.
projects.audience: Beginners who want a plain first step.
projects.number: Visitors who start the first lesson each week.
